steps.prompt: $46$ children split into two equal teams. How many are in each team?

cards.title: Halving undoes doubling
cards.body: Half of a number is what you double to get it. Double $8$ is $16$, so half of $16$ is $8$. Halving means sharing into two equal parts.

steps.text: Split $68$ into $60$ and $8$. Halve the tens.
Halve the ones: half of $8$ is $4$.
So half of $68$ is $34$. Check: double $34$ is $68$.

cards.title: Odd tens
cards.body: Half of $70$: split it into $60$ and $10$. Half of $60$ is $30$, half of $10$ is $5$, so half of $70$ is $35$. Half of an odd number of tens ends in $5$.

prompts: How can doubling help you check a half?
